summary: Describes a way to have an arbitrary number of Rendezvous Points per group in a single PIM Sparse Mode domain by combining PIM and the Multicast Source Discovery Protocol. This gives load sharing and redundancy for multicast rendezvous.

eli5.summary: In multicast, everyone meets at a rendezvous point. This note lets several machines share the same meeting-point address, so if one fails, another takes over.
